SELECT s.signalregistry AS signal_id,
       s.signalclass AS signal_type,
       ROUND((1 - ABS(s.freqdrifthzs) / (s.freqmhz * 1000.0)) * (s.sigdursec / (1 + s.doppshifthz / 1000.0)), 3) AS ssm,
       'Frequency: ' || d.freqstab || ', Phase: ' || d.phasestab || ', Integrity: ' || d.sigintegrity AS stability_report,
       CASE WHEN (1 - ABS(s.freqdrifthzs) / (s.freqmhz * 1000.0)) * (s.sigdursec / (1 + s.doppshifthz / 1000.0)) > 0.8
                 AND c.entropyval BETWEEN 0.4 AND 0.8 AND s.modindex > 0.5
            THEN 'Coherent Information Pattern Detected'
            WHEN (1 - ABS(s.freqdrifthzs) / (s.freqmhz * 1000.0)) * (s.sigdursec / (1 + s.doppshifthz / 1000.0)) > 0.6
                 AND c.entropyval BETWEEN 0.3 AND 0.9
            THEN 'Potential Information Pattern'
            ELSE 'No Clear Pattern' END AS cip_classification
FROM signals s
JOIN signalclassification c ON c.signalref = s.signalregistry
JOIN signaldynamics d ON d.signalref = s.signalregistry

WITH v AS (
  SELECT o.observstation AS observstation,
         (p.techsigprob * 4 + p.biosigprob / 100.0 + p.sigunique * 2 + p.anomscore / 2.0) * (1 - p.falseposprob) AS rpi,
         (1 - p.falseposprob) * d.decodeconf *
           (CASE WHEN s.snrratio - 0.1 * ABS(s.noisefloordbm) > 0
                 THEN (s.snrratio - 0.1 * ABS(s.noisefloordbm)) / 10.0 + 0.5 ELSE 0.1 END) AS ccs
  FROM signals s
  JOIN telescopes t ON s.telescref = t.telescregistry
  JOIN observatories o ON t.observstation = o.observstation
  JOIN signalprobabilities p ON p.signalref = s.signalregistry
  JOIN signaldecoding d ON d.signalref = s.signalregistry
)
SELECT observstation AS observatory_name,
       COUNT(*) AS total_signals,
       AVG(rpi) AS avg_rpi,
       AVG(ccs) AS avg_ccs,
       SUM(CASE WHEN rpi > 3 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS high_priority_signals,
       SUM(CASE WHEN ccs > 0.8 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS high_confidence_signals,
       SUM(CASE WHEN rpi > 3 AND ccs > 0.8 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS high_priority_high_confidence_signals
FROM v
GROUP BY observstation
ORDER BY high_priority_high_confidence_signals DESC

SELECT s.signalregistry AS signal_id,
       s.centerfreqmhz AS center_frequency_mhz,
       s.freqdrifthzs AS frequency_drift_hzs,
       s.bwhz / (s.centerfreqmhz * 1000000.0) AS bfr,
       CASE WHEN s.bwhz / (s.centerfreqmhz * 1000000.0) < 0.0001 AND s.freqdrifthzs < 0.1 AND s.modtype <> 'Unknown'
            THEN 'Strong NTM'
            WHEN s.bwhz / (s.centerfreqmhz * 1000000.0) < 0.0005 AND s.freqdrifthzs < 0.5 AND s.modtype <> 'Unknown'
            THEN 'Moderate NTM'
            ELSE 'Not NTM' END AS ntm_classification
FROM signals s

WITH v AS (
  SELECT o.observstation AS observstation, t.telescregistry AS telescregistry,
         t.equipstatus AS equipstatus, t.calibrstatus AS calibrstatus, t.coolsysstatus AS coolsysstatus,
         t.pointaccarc AS pointaccarc,
         o.atmostransparency * (1 - o.humidityrate / 100.0) * (1 - 0.02 * o.windspeedms) AS aoi,
         (1 - o.lunardistdeg / 180.0) * (1 - o.atmostransparency) AS lif
  FROM telescopes t
  JOIN observatories o ON t.observstation = o.observstation
)
SELECT observstation AS station_name,
       telescregistry AS telescope_id,
       aoi * (1 - lif) * (CASE WHEN pointaccarc < 2 THEN 1 ELSE 2.0 / pointaccarc END) AS oqf,
       RTRIM((CASE WHEN equipstatus <> 'Operational' THEN 'Equipment: ' || equipstatus || ', ' ELSE '' END) ||
             (CASE WHEN calibrstatus <> 'Current' THEN 'Calibration: ' || calibrstatus || ', ' ELSE '' END) ||
             (CASE WHEN coolsysstatus <> 'Normal' THEN 'Cooling: ' || coolsysstatus || ', ' ELSE '' END), ', ') AS equipment_problems,
       (CASE WHEN equipstatus <> 'Operational' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)
       + (CASE WHEN calibrstatus <> 'Current' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)
       + (CASE WHEN coolsysstatus <> 'Normal' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS issue_count,
       CASE WHEN aoi > 0.8 AND equipstatus = 'Operational' AND calibrstatus = 'Current' THEN 'High'
            WHEN aoi >= 0.5 AND aoi <= 0.8 THEN 'Medium'
            ELSE 'Low' END AS observational_confidence_level
FROM v
ORDER BY oqf DESC

WITH v AS (
  SELECT s.signalregistry AS signalregistry, s.modtype AS modtype, s.snrratio AS snr,
         s.modindex * (1 + (1 - ABS(s.freqdrifthzs) / (s.freqmhz * 1000.0)) * (s.sigdursec / (1 + s.doppshifthz / 1000.0)))
           * (CASE s.modtype WHEN 'AM' THEN 2 WHEN 'FM' THEN 1.5 ELSE 1 END) AS mcs
  FROM signals s
)
SELECT modtype AS modulation_type,
       COUNT(*) AS signal_count,
       AVG(mcs) AS avg_mcs,
       AVG(snr) AS avg_snr,
       json_group_object(signalregistry, json_object('mcs', mcs, 'snr', snr)) AS signal_details
FROM v
GROUP BY modtype
HAVING COUNT(*) >= 5

WITH v AS (
  SELECT p.techsigprob * (1 - p.natsrcprob) * p.sigunique * (0.5 + p.anomscore / 10.0) AS tols,
         s.bwhz / (s.centerfreqmhz * 1000000.0) AS bfr,
         p.anomscore AS anomscore
  FROM signals s
  JOIN signalprobabilities p ON p.signalref = s.signalregistry
)
SELECT CASE WHEN tols < 0.25 THEN 'Low' WHEN tols < 0.75 THEN 'Medium' ELSE 'High' END AS tols_category,
       COUNT(*) AS signal_count,
       AVG(bfr) AS avg_bfr,
       SQRT((SUM(anomscore * anomscore) - SUM(anomscore) * SUM(anomscore) / COUNT(anomscore)) / (COUNT(anomscore) - 1)) AS stddev_anomscore
FROM v
GROUP BY tols_category

SELECT lunarstage AS moon_phase,
       AVG((1 - lunardistdeg / 180.0) * (1 - atmostransparency)) AS avg_lif,
       SUM(CASE WHEN (1 - lunardistdeg / 180.0) * (1 - atmostransparency) > 0.5 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS high_lif_events
FROM observatories
GROUP BY lunarstage
ORDER BY avg_lif DESC

WITH v AS (
  SELECT o.weathprofile AS weather_condition,
         s.snrratio - 0.1 * ABS(s.noisefloordbm) AS snqi
  FROM signals s
  JOIN telescopes t ON s.telescref = t.telescregistry
  JOIN observatories o ON t.observstation = o.observstation
),
r AS (
  SELECT weather_condition, snqi,
         ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY weather_condition ORDER BY snqi) AS rn,
         COUNT(*) OVER (PARTITION BY weather_condition) AS c
  FROM v
),
m AS (
  SELECT weather_condition, AVG(snqi) AS median_snqi
  FROM r
  WHERE rn IN ((c + 1) / 2, (c + 2) / 2)
  GROUP BY weather_condition
)
SELECT v.weather_condition AS weather_condition,
       AVG(v.snqi) AS avg_snqi,
       m.median_snqi AS median_snqi,
       SUM(CASE WHEN v.snqi > 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS analyzable_signal_count
FROM v
JOIN m ON m.weather_condition = v.weather_condition
GROUP BY v.weather_condition, m.median_snqi
ORDER BY avg_snqi DESC

WITH ts AS (
  SELECT o.observstation AS observstation,
         p.techsigprob * (1 - p.natsrcprob) * p.sigunique * (0.5 + p.anomscore / 10.0) AS tols,
         s.bwhz / (s.centerfreqmhz * 1000000.0) AS bfr
  FROM signals s
  JOIN telescopes t ON s.telescref = t.telescregistry
  JOIN observatories o ON t.observstation = o.observstation
  JOIN signalprobabilities p ON p.signalref = s.signalregistry
  JOIN signalclassification c ON c.signalref = s.signalregistry
  WHERE p.techsigprob > 0.7 AND p.natsrcprob < 0.3 AND p.artsrcprob < 50
    AND s.bwhz / (s.centerfreqmhz * 1000000.0) < 0.001
    AND c.infodense > 0.8
)
SELECT observstation AS observatory_name,
       COUNT(*) AS technosignature_count,
       AVG(tols) AS avg_tols,
       AVG(bfr) AS avg_bfr,
       COUNT(*) * 100.0 / (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM ts) AS pct_of_all_technosignatures
FROM ts
GROUP BY observstation
ORDER BY technosignature_count DESC

WITH v AS (
  SELECT observstation,
         atmostransparency * (1 - humidityrate / 100.0) * (1 - 0.02 * windspeedms) AS aoi,
         lunarstage, lunardistdeg, solarstatus
  FROM observatories
)
SELECT (aoi > 0.85 AND lunarstage IN ('New', 'First Quarter') AND lunardistdeg > 45
        AND solarstatus IN ('Low', 'Moderate')) AS meets_oow,
       COUNT(*) AS station_count,
       ROUND(AVG(aoi), 3) AS avg_aoi,
       json_group_array(json_object('station', observstation,
                                    'aoi', ROUND(aoi, 3),
                                    'lunar_factors', json_object('stage', lunarstage, 'distance', lunardistdeg),
                                    'solar_status', solarstatus)) AS stations
FROM v
GROUP BY meets_oow
